text: Deploying api v1.42 to prod at 17:00 UTC. Includes the rate-limit headers and the session TTL change.

Who knows the PayStream webhook flow? Finance says two payments show as pending in our admin but settled in PayStream.

That's me. Webhooks land on `/hooks/paystream`, get queued, and the reconciler marks invoices paid. We dropped two events during the 17:00 deploy window. I'll replay them from the PayStream dashboard; the handler is idempotent on `event_id` so replays are safe.
Replayed, both invoices now paid. Filed BIL-24 to add a nightly reconciliation sweep so we don't depend on webhooks alone.
